# Online Teleprompter

> A free, open-source online teleprompter (在线提词器) that scrolls at the user's speaking pace, measured in words per minute (characters per minute for Chinese, Japanese and Korean), instead of a fixed pixel speed. It runs entirely in the browser: no server, no account, no analytics; scripts stay in the browser's local storage.

Key facts:

- URL: https://online-teleprompter.vercel.app/ (Chinese: https://online-teleprompter.vercel.app/zh/)
- Source: https://github.com/Noxr3/online-teleprompter (Apache-2.0)
- Price: free, no sign-up
- Pacing: each line stays on the reading line in proportion to the words it holds; default 150 words/min for English, 280 characters/min for Chinese; or set the talk length in minutes and the pace is calculated
- Script format: `## Title` starts a page, one line per sentence, `**words**` are stressed
- Stage: reading line, dimmed past lines, page jumps, pace and text-size controls, timer, mirror mode for beam-splitter teleprompter glass, full screen, screen wake lock
- Works in desktop and mobile browsers; interface in English and Simplified Chinese
- Import and export scripts as Markdown
- Self-hostable static site with no dependencies and no build step; one-click deploy to Vercel
- Made by Brad (https://github.com/Noxr3), founder of Dokki (https://dokki.one)
